{"type":"thought","data":"The National Weather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Service forecast was"}
{"type":"thought","data":" created on October "}
{"type":"thought","data":"9 evening."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe forecast shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only a 30% chance of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" measurable rain before"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 7am on October 10. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"After that, the weather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" becomes sunny and clear"}
{"type":"thought","data":" through the weekend."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market prices Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.19 and No at 0.81."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.19 is slightly below"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the NWS forecast probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This suggests Yes may"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be underpriced if the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" forecast remains valid."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The forecast was issued"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on October 9 at 7:53"}
{"type":"thought","data":" PM CDT, so I need to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" verify whether the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"early morning rain window"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has already passed "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and whether it actually"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rained.\n\nThe system date is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 10. The weather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" data may be frozen "}
{"type":"thought","data":"from the previous evening"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as part of the benchmark"}
{"type":"thought","data":" simulation. I need "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to check the actual "}
{"type":"thought","data":"system clock."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe weather.gov JSON"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows a current observation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" timestamp of October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 9 at 7:53 PM CDT. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirms the benchmark"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is frozen on that evening"}
{"type":"thought","data":" snapshot. The early"}
{"type":"thought","data":" morning rain window"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has likely already "}
{"type":"thought","data":"passed."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe quantitative precipitation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" forecast shows 0.04"}
{"type":"thought","data":" inches for one 12-hour"}
{"type":"thought","data":" period and zero for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the next. The point"}
{"type":"thought","data":" forecast matrix lists"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 40% and 5% PoP. I need"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to verify whether NWS"}
{"type":"thought","data":" QPF represents an unconditional"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mean or a conditional"}
{"type":"thought","data":" amount."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNWS QPF is an unconditional"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mean, not a conditional"}
{"type":"thought","data":" amount. With 0.04 inches"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected and a 40% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"chance of rain, the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"conditional rainfall"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would be roughly 0.10"}
{"type":"thought","data":" inches. That exceeds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 0.01 inch threshold"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for measurable precipitation."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe tabular forecast"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lists 20/40 PoP for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Saturday. I am checking"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the NWS SFT documentation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to confirm whether "}
{"type":"thought","data":"those percentages represent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" nighttime or daytime"}
{"type":"thought","data":" periods."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe NWS SFT documentation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" indicates the first"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability listed "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is nighttime and the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" second is daytime. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Saturday's 20/40 therefore"}
{"type":"thought","data":" means 20% rain from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Friday evening to Saturday"}
{"type":"thought","data":" morning, and 40% from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Saturday morning to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" afternoon. Sunday shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" zero probability for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both periods."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe evening update"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shifted the rain window"}
{"type":"thought","data":" earlier, dropping Saturday"}
{"type":"thought","data":" daytime PoP from 40%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 30%. The JSON forecast"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is the most authoritative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" source. Saturday night"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows zero probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of showers. The October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 10 climate day runs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from midnight to midnight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" local standard time."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nDuring daylight saving"}
{"type":"thought","data":" time, local standard"}
{"type":"thought","data":" time is one hour behind"}
{"type":"thought","data":" CDT. NWS stations reset"}
{"type":"thought","data":" precipitation accumulations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at midnight local standard"}
{"type":"thought","data":" time, which corresponds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 1:00 AM CDT. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 9 CLI report shows zero rainfall through 4 PM."}

Fri Oct 9 2026\n\n...New AVIATION...\n\n.KEY MESSAGES...\nUpdated at 520 PM CDT Fri Oct 9 2026\n\n- Small Craft Advisories are in place for most of the tidal lakes\n  through this evening. Tropical Storm Warnings and Hurricane\n  Warnings are in place for offshore waters.\n\n- Hurricane Isaias is expected to make landfall on the north\n  central Gulf Coast this evening. Southeastern LA coastal areas\n  plus inland Jackson County and all of Hancock and Harrison\n  Counties MS are under a Tropical Storm Warning and coastal\n  Jackson County MS is under a Hurricane Warning. Much of coastal\n  southeast LA and coastal MS are under Storm Surge Warnings.\n\n- Potential impacts from Hurricane Isaias include blustery to\n  damaging winds, coastal flooding, and dangerous waves/seas on\n  the coastal waters.\n\n&&\n\n.SHORT TERM...\n(Now through Monday night)\nIssued at 104 PM CDT Fri Oct 9 2026\n\nStill watching Isaias and its local impacts. Associated watches\nand warnings expected to hold through tomorrow afternoon or\nevening. {"type":"thought","data":"has a `--max-price` "}
{"type":"thought","data":"option. The default "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is the best ask."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe No ask is 0.83"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with size 105. That"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely covers the 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet. The Yes ask is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.21 with size 27. "}

{"type":"thought","data":" to 0.22."}

{"type":"thought","data":"roughly $87.15, so the"}

{"type":"thought","data":"Checking hourly probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of precipitation for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 10 in New Orleans"}
{"type":"thought","data":" local time."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe highest hourly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" PoP is 36% at 06:00"}
{"type":"thought","data":" CDT. This aligns with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the TAF PROB30 window"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for 11-12Z. The probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of measurable rain "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for the entire day is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly the maximum"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hourly chance."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe independent union"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of all hourly probabilities"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reaches roughly 72.5%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" That is far too high"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because the hours are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correlated. The actual"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of measurable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rain for the day should"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be closer to the maximum"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hourly PoP."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 30% daytime PoP"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the 20% evening"}
{"type":"thought","data":" PoP are the grid forecast's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" main signals. The 36%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hourly peak at 6 AM"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is the same passing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" band. The 12-hour PoP"}
{"type":"thought","data":" equals the maximum "}
{"type":"thought","data":"hourly chance."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe daily probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of measurable rain "}
{"type":"thought","data":"on October 10 is estimated"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at roughly 25 to 40"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent, centered near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 30 to 35 percent. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 36 percent hourly peak"}
{"type":"thought","data":" serves as the main "}
{"type":"thought","data":"signal for a single "}
{"type":"thought","data":"passing shower window."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Several hours carry"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 10 percent or higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chances, so the total"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability sits slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above that peak."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe TAF PROB30 is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"pinned to exactly 11–12Z,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a one-hour window. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"That tight timing makes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 36% chance the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"most likely hour and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the neighboring hours"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lower. The probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mass is concentrated"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at that single spike."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 3 AM and 6 AM "}
{"type":"thought","data":"hourly probabilities"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may be two separate"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rain features. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"TAF only lists one probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" group for the 11–12Z"}
{"type":"thought","data":" window, so the earlier"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hour likely reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a different system."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If they are independent,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the daily chance of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" measurable rain could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rise to roughly 35–45"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.19 is far below the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimated true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 32 to 40"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market was set "}
{"type":"thought","data":"before the latest forecast"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and reflects an earlier"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lower probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe NWS PoP likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overestimates measurable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rain at the official"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ASOS when showers are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" very light and spotty."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The AFD describes a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" dry, pleasant day with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only slight chance "}
{"type":"thought","data":"of very light lingering"}
{"type":"thought","data":" showers. Forecasters"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may be inflating the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" grid probability relative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to their narrative."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This suggests the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price is inefficient"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and offers an edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 36% hourly PoP"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely reflects raw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" National Blend of Models"}
{"type":"thought","data":" output rather than "}
{"type":"thought","data":"fully edited forecast."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The AFD narrative calls"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for a \"slight chance\""}
{"type":"thought","data":" (20%) of very light"}
{"type":"thought","data":" showers, but the grid"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows \"Chance Rain "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Showers\" at 36%. That"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gap suggests the NWS"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" higher than the human"}
{"type":"thought","data":" forecaster's estimate."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe afternoon NWS "}
{"type":"thought","data":"grid was updated at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"4:42 PM CDT, after the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" AFD short-term discussion"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 1:04 PM. That later"}
{"type":"thought","data":" update likely raised"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the probability of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"precipitation.\n\nThe "}
{"type":"thought","data":"latest TAF from 6:20"}
{"type":"thought","data":" PM CDT lists a one-hour"}
{"type":"thought","data":" PROB30 for light showers."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This means aviation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" forecasters estimate"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 30 percent chance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for that single hour."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nConditional on the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" PROB30 light-shower"}
{"type":"thought","data":" event occurring, measurable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rain is likely. Visibility"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 4SM with -SHRA and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mist typically indicates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" light precipitation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rates around 0.05 to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.10 inches per hour."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Even a brief occurrence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probably produces at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" least 0.01 inch. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of measurable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rain given the event"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is estimated at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 70 to 80 percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe TAF probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of about 30 percent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" times the roughly 75"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent chance of measurable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rain yields an estimated"}
{"type":"thought","data":" daily probability near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 22.5 percent. That "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is slightly below the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price of 19 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"percent, giving a potential"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge of roughly six"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to thirteen percentage"}
{"type":"thought","data":" points.\n\nA bet on Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at the ask price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 21 percent would yield"}
{"type":"thought","data":" an expected value of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 33 tokens if "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 28 percent. At 22"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent the expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value is only about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 4.7 tokens, and at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"20 percent it turns "}
{"type":"thought","data":"negative at roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"minus 4.8 tokens.\n\nA bet on No is negative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value at the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ask price. The vig "}
{"type":"thought","data":"makes it unprofitable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" unless the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of no rain exceeds "}
{"type":"thought","data":"83 percent. Yes is the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only positive expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value side, since the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimated true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sits above the 21 percent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" break-even threshold."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNo is the more likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome, but Yes offers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the higher expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payoff. In this competition,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the round winner is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" determined by who holds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the correct side, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by total profit and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" loss. A No bettor wins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the round when the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market closes No, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a Yes bettor wins it"}
{"type":"thought","data":" when the market closes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes. The payout gap"}
{"type":"thought","data":" between the two outcomes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is large enough that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" winning the round is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a meaningful goal."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe other agents will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely follow the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and bet No. I should"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet Yes to win the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"round. My prior record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of two losses on underdogs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is a reminder that "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the goal is to beat "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the competition, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" just maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" refers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to the probability of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the outcome itself,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":" No is the more probable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side. However, in a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L competition with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a mispriced market,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" taking the positive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value is the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correct strategy. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" best ask for Yes is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 21 percent and the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"best bid is 17 percent,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so the displayed mid"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price of 19 percent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sits between them. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"I will use --max-price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.21 to ensure I only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" take the best ask."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 0.21 ask offers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only 105 shares, costing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 22 tokens. Buying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" through the book to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reach 100 tokens would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" require walking up "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to 0.35 and then 0.60,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which would push the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" average price far above"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWalking the book to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 100 tokens costs roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 278 shares at an average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price near 36 percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":" That slippage turns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bet negative after"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a win. The best ask"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and next bid together"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yield only about 165"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shares for 35 tokens,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" leaving the full 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stake uncovered."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe default max-price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 0.26, which still"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only covers about 35"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens. I need to know"}
{"type":"thought","data":" whether the order fails"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or partially fills "}
{"type":"thought","data":"when the stake exceeds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" available liquidity."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The size unit might"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be in dollars rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than shares."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nOrder book sizes are in outcome shares, not dollars. A 100-token bet would consume shares until the stake is exhausted. The No side has enough liquidity within the default max-price of 0.88 to fill about 120 shares for roughly 100 tokens. That yields a payout of about 120 tokens and a profit of about 20 tokens."}

{"type":"thought","data":"The client forwards "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the bet to the orchestrator."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 100-token stake"}
{"type":"thought","data":" defaults to max-price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at best ask plus 0.05."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Resolution requires"}
{"type":"thought","data":" KMSY CLI precipitation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of at least 0.01 inches on October 10 midnight-to-midnight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" local time. KMSY currently"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows no precipitation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and is dry. Hurricane"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Isaias has landed well"}
{"type":"thought","data":" east of New Orleans,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" leaving the city on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the dry western side."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe latest AFD and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" TAF show only light"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rain and mist Saturday"}
{"type":"thought","data":" morning. The hourly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" NWS PoP for October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 10 peaks at 36% around"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 6 AM and drops to zero"}
{"type":"thought","data":" after 10 AM. The market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price is 0.19 for Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 0.81 for No."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe NWS PoP already"}
{"type":"thought","data":" measures the chance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of measurable precipitation,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so it should not include"}
{"type":"thought","data":" trace rainfall. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" human AFD's \"slight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance\" of very light"}
{"type":"thought","data":" showers is the more"}
{"type":"thought","data":" relevant figure. Trace"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rainfall does not count"}
{"type":"thought","data":" toward the 0.01-inch threshold."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nForecasters and models"}
{"type":"thought","data":" can be biased. Tropical"}
{"type":"thought","data":" cyclone outer bands often produce trace"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rainfall at ASOS stations."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNew Orleans normally"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sees about 0.11 inches"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of daily precipitation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in October, with measurable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rain on roughly seven or eight days. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"climatological daily"}
{"type":"thought","data":" PoP is around twenty-five"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent.\n\nTomorrow "}
{"type":"thought","data":"should fall below that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" average because it "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is a post-tropical dry northwest flow day."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Only the morning leftover"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shower chance remains."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 19% sits between the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" official NWS grid at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 30% and other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" forecasters at 5% to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 12%. WindBorne shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 0.1 mm chance, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is trace rainfall and does not count toward"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 0.01-inch threshold."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWindBorne's 0.1 mm"}
{"type":"thought","data":" QPF equals only 0.004"}
{"type":"thought","data":" inches, so the probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of exceeding the 0.01-inch"}
{"type":"thought","data":" threshold is very low."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The NWS morning forecast"}
{"type":"thought","data":" had a 0.04 inch QPF"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with 40% PoP before"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the storm track became"}
{"type":"thought","data":" clearer; the evening"}

{"type":"thought","data":"backed off."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA local meteorologist"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at NOLA.com estimates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 7% chance of rain"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Saturday. This "}
{"type":"thought","data":"conflicts with the official"}
{"type":"thought","data":" NWS TAF, which still"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lists a 30% probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for one hour. The NWS"}
{"type":"thought","data":" grid from 4:42 PM may"}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe NOLA.com 7% estimate"}

{"type":"thought","data":"PROB30 for light rain"}

{"type":"thought","data":"not probability. New"}
